description: React component for displaying and managing key information, including viewing, editing, regenerating, and deleting a virtual key, with UI elements for key details, permissions, logs, and settings.

methods.name: handleKeyUpdate
methods.description: Handles updating key data via form submission, including data sanitization, metadata parsing, and API call.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Deletes the key by calling the API and manages modal states.

methods.name: copyToClipboard
methods.description: Copies given text to clipboard and shows feedback.

methods.name: handleRegenerateKeyUpdate
methods.description: Updates local state upon key regeneration and triggers UI updates.

methods.name: formatTimestamp
methods.description: Formats date/timestamp into a human-readable string.
